items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Lorenzo Flenoy (PHONETIC), he was a terrific pianist, had the band at the Club Alabam when I first came here.

ctx.x: It was later on that I went to all the clubs, but at the time I went to them the Alabam was still open and the Alabam was the largest and the most lavish and it had floor shows along with whatever music.

Tremendous musicians. Lorenzo Flenoy (PHONETIC), he was a terrific pianist, had the band at the Club Alabam when I first came here. And some of those guys have gone on, but some of the guys are still around that worked in that band. There was --
Who else was in the band?
